22. What is meant by the term active mass? Express the active mass of the reactants in
following reaction 2P + Q -..—-............-+ products.

Active mass: The term 'active mass' of any species is equivalents to the molar concentration of that species. It is expressed in square brackets [ I which is raised to a power equal to stoichiometric coefficient in balanced chemical equation. For example, the active mass of substance 'A' is expressed by [A] or CA.
The term 'molar concentration i.e. molarity of a substance means the no. of gram moles substance dissolved per unit volume of its solution.
